needed.evidence: The left side has no purpose-built sidewalk; the area is a narrow, uneven strip of dirt and gravel directly adjacent to the road, cluttered with parked vehicles
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, 1.5m-wide footway on the left side, set back from the carriageway, to provide a safe and level surface for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the left is completely obstructed by a row of parked motorcycles and a red car, forcing pedestrians to walk in the road
needed.suggestion: Implement a no-parking zone on the left side of the road to keep the pedestrian path clear of vehicles and goods.

needed.evidence: The ground on the left is uneven, with visible potholes, loose gravel, and debris, creating significant trip hazards for anyone walking there
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left-side path with a smooth, level material to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

needed.evidence: The right-side sidewalk has a broken, uneven surface with visible cracks and debris, posing a trip risk to pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Repair the damaged sections of the right-side sidewalk to create a smooth, continuous walking surface.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the presence of shops and people on both sides, but no marked or purpose-built crossing facility is visible
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked zebra crossing at a logical point along this stretch to provide a safe and visible place for pedestrians to cross.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the road in any of the frames, which would make the area dark and unsafe at night
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users during the evening and night.
